object_description: compact rectangular hall volume with a slightly sloping gable roof
design_condition: The hall extends the construction area to fit the orthogonal school complex, while slight terrain changes connect varied access levels and create a forecourt, break area, and court sequence.

positive.statement: The separation of work classes and sports activities is relatively possible without special measures.

position.target: separation of work classes and sports activities
position.rationale: Interior functional separation is not distinguishable; estimated across the hall’s sampled central zones.

positive.statement: The compact building volume provides tightly and clearly organized access areas.

position.target: compact building volume and access areas
position.rationale: Compact rectangular mass is visible; access areas are approximated along the south-facing entrance side.

positive.statement: The polyvalent foyer and gallery meet reasonable expectations in this rural environment.

position.rationale: Interior foyer and gallery are unidentifiable; positioned near the hall’s plausible central circulation zone.

negative.statement: The simple rectangular hall is disproportionate to the small-grain surroundings and appears as an oversized giant barn.

position.rationale: The complete compact rectangular hall and slightly sloping gable roof are clearly visible across all calibrated views.

negative.statement: The western corner violates the program by extending the already expanded construction area.

position.rationale: Western corner is localized on the left side of the rectangular footprint and adjacent elevations.

negative.statement: The inline court is hidden from the building, and little concrete design is provided for the breaks and playgrounds.

position.rationale: Exterior court and playgrounds are not distinguishable; estimated immediately south of the sampled hall footprint.

negative.statement: The exposed aggregate concrete facade and corrugated-iron roof appear cheap and aesthetically unsatisfactory.

position.target: exposed aggregate concrete facade and corrugated-iron roof
position.rationale: Facade surfaces and roof form are visible, though material finishes are only weakly represented by points.

negative.statement: The addition makes only a small contribution to improving the heterogeneous school complex.

position.rationale: The sampled hall is identifiable as a compact addition, but the heterogeneous surrounding complex is absent.
